title: Rainfall-associated expansion of frog active communities crosses spatial and taxonomic boundaries without practical homogenization
frozen_core_claims: Recent-rain conditions are associated with expansion of the behaviourally realized acoustic community across active spatial footprint, local alpha richness and route gamma richness.

The exact species x stop incidence allocation strongly rejects a magnitude-matched uniform-activation null that applies one common log-odds shift to dry-side acoustic propensities; the omnibus Monte Carlo p-value is 0.000999 under kappa 1, 2 and 5.
Under the primary kappa=2 null, boundary crossing is 92.0 percent observed versus an 80.9 percent null mean and a 74.2-87.4 percent 95 percent null interval.

Corner expansion and taxonomic deepening are overrepresented relative to uniform activation, whereas spatial spread and within-core rearrangement are underrepresented; within-core rearrangement is 8.0 percent observed versus 19.1 percent expected.

The rainfall-contrast slope of mean pairwise Sorensen dissimilarity is practically equivalent to zero within the fixed post hoc +/-0.025 slope margin in both the primary and exact-consecutive-year samples.
The multiscale footprint/alpha/gamma signal is robust to omission of any single sampled state, recorded detection-condition adjustment and the primary three-day protocol-window sensitivity.
frozen_interpretation: Boundary-biased expansion without practical homogenization: recent-rain acoustic-community growth is more taxonomically recruiting and less core-rearranging than a magnitude-matched uniform activation process predicts, while pairwise Sorensen differentiation remains practically stable within a fixed margin.
frozen_negative_boundaries: Uniform-null rejection does not identify a unique biological mechanism.
Heterogeneous activation thresholds remain a literature-supported Discussion hypothesis, not an identified mechanism.
Activation geometry remains falsified as a rainfall-specific species trait.
No rainfall causality, occupancy, abundance, colonization, extinction or demographic-connectivity claim.
No claim that every state has the same response.
No claim of exact beta-diversity invariance or equivalence of every beta metric.
No long-duration rainfall-pulse or physiological half-life claim.
